private_records.release_rule: Provide the current account ID. You approve releases only when no personal data is involved; if contact names are included, say the CTO approves.
Provide the current inventory for Contoso.
Approve only with account, categories and count cited.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.
